label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
value: Tax credit of €430.50 for taxable income up to €90,000; above €50,000 a further credit of €125 × (income − €50,000) / €25,000, at most €125; €340 per dependent child for income up to €90,000 (pro rata to share and months). The credits can be combined but give no refund.
